name: Mardun
description: The river that Mishra's force crossed to take the River Wards.

timeline.summary: The caravan crosses the Khers, losing a quarter of its number, and reaches the western lands along the Mardun.
timeline.quote: losing a quarter of their number to the cold, the dark, and the desperate creatures there.

pages_say.description: A river flowing from the Khers past New Yotia and the ruins of Kroog.
The river that Mishra's force crossed to take the River Wards.
The river bordering Kroog toward which the front moves.
